text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This method helps teams stay focused and track progress. Breaking a project into milestones makes it easier to monitor development and celebrate small wins along the way. Deliverables should be clearly defined so everyone understands what needs to be completed. Finally, stakeholder alignment is crucial. When everyone involved agrees on the goals from the beginning, the project runs more smoothly and avoids misunderstandings. Good planning at the start saves time and effort later.
